meta.title: Optimize GitHub sync functionality by using lastSyncedState instead of remote pulls
meta.body_summary: Optimize GitHub sync by using lastSyncedState to skip remote pulls and only push changed files, reducing API calls and sync time.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot PR to optimize GitHub sync via lastSyncedState; no human reviews, closed after ~1 year inactivity with no merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 709 changed lines, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, concentrated in a new utility, tests, and modifications to sync logic. As a performance optimization PR, it was closed without review engagement, consistent with many stale agent PRs.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or substantive feedback provided; the only comment is from changeset-bot noting missing changeset. PR remained open for over a year before closure without human review.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce GitHub API calls and data transfer by using lastSyncedState to avoid unnecessary remote pulls and only push changed files.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed after ~1 year inactivity; no human review engagement or requested changes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR's substance (sync optimization) is technically plausible, but without maintainer engagement and no benchmark validation, the process boundary prevented merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: No human review text; no code reading evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes testing commands and narrative claims about reduced API calls, but no benchmark data or reproduction steps for performance measurement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after prolonged inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: Added determineFileChanges utility to compare current state with lastSyncedState, identifying file-level changes (create/update/delete). Integrated into GitHub sync flow to skip remote pull and only push changed files. Also added writeChangesetOptimized method and comprehensive tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files add substantial line count; selectors/index.ts export addition is minor.
change_trajectory: Implementation of determineFileChanges, changes to github.tsx, GithubTokenStorage.ts, and unit tests.
Follow-up fix for build errors and export tokenFormatSelector.

review_signals.summary: Noted that no changeset was included; this is a packaging concern, not a performance review.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with sync optimization, unit tests, and integration tests.
Changeset bot commented on missing changeset.
No human review occurred; PR left open for over a year before closure.
